records.title: B Main Nanoswarm Lineup beside the Green Crate
records.description: From the B Main position shown in the clip, face the entrance and use the upper roof and hanging-lantern reference shown for the throw. The Nanoswarm lands on the B Site floor beside the central green crate. Match the exact standing point and aim height to the original clip; trigger it when the Spike is planted in the covered corner.

source.author: KtM_civil
source.evidence: Tracker identifies the creator clip as Killjoy attack, titled OP Summit lineup on B site; its description says B Site. The full original 21.6-second embedded clip was reviewed at the B Main setup, Nanoswarm release, and B Site landing. The minimap and visible floor plan confirm Summit and the swarm lands beside the central green crate. Summit was introduced in patch 13.00; Riot notes through 13.08 list no Summit geometry change to the B Main-to-B Site throw path or landing floor. Compatibility is inferred from those unchanged local landmarks; not tested in a live match.
source.rightsBasis: The guide and its original Tracker-hosted video remain linked and embedded on Tracker. No video, image, thumbnail or screenshot was copied or rehosted.
